photos.view: close-up of front corner and wheel arch of a dark blue car, with a grey/silver panel at left

vehicle_check.seen: Dark blue vehicle, front wing and wheel arch close-up, with a silver-grey panel (another car or bumper) touching the front

findings.reason: Front wing is crumpled and creased near the front edge and the wheel-arch lip is bent inward, with heavy paint transfer and scraping.
The front corner next to the wing looks displaced or detached, with the headlamp area and mounting brackets exposed, but it is unclear which part is missing.

structural_reason: The wheel-arch lip is bent and the front corner is pushed in with exposed brackets, so the impact may have reached the mounting structure behind the panel.
